# ChamPDF API — for AI agents and developers

ChamPDF is a document, image, and video toolkit. This file describes its
public REST API so an LLM-based agent (or a human) can call it directly.
Machine-readable spec: GET /openapi.json. Interactive docs: GET /docs.

## Base URL

https://champdf-api.64.227.154.215.sslip.io

(All paths below are relative to this base. This is the current production
host; a friendlier api.champdf.com may front it later, so read the base URL
from this file rather than hard-coding it.)

## Authentication

Every request needs:

    Authorization: Bearer champdf_live_<your key>

Get a key by signing in at https://champdf.com, then opening the "API" pill
next to your account avatar and clicking "Generate API key". The raw key is
shown once — store it somewhere safe. Free tier: 1,000 requests/month,
30 requests/minute burst.

Check your key's status any time:

    GET /api/v1/whoami
    -> {"id":1,"label":"...","monthly_quota":1000,"requests_used":12,
        "month_bucket":"2026-07","scopes":["*"]}

Rotate or revoke from the same "API" panel on the site, or via:

    GET    /api/v1/keys/me          status of your key
    POST   /api/v1/keys/me          create your key (409 if one exists)
    POST   /api/v1/keys/me/rotate   revoke + reissue
    DELETE /api/v1/keys/me          revoke

## Feature discovery

    GET /api/v1/capabilities

Returns which optional engines are enabled on this deployment (e.g. OCR,
signing, LibreOffice conversion). Not every feature is on everywhere —
check this before assuming an endpoint works, or just try it: a disabled
feature returns 503 rather than a silent failure.

## Endpoints

All multipart uploads use standard `multipart/form-data`. All PDFs are
capped at 50MB. Files are processed in memory / temp storage and are not
retained after the response is sent.

### Documents

| Method | Path                       | Request                                          | Response                          |
|--------|----------------------------|---------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| POST   | /api/v1/pdf/merge          | `files` (2+ PDFs)                                  | merged PDF                        |
| POST   | /api/v1/pdf/split          | `file`, `pages` (e.g. `"1-3,7,9-"`)                 | PDF of just those pages           |
| POST   | /api/v1/pdf/delete-pages   | `file`, `pages`                                    | PDF without those pages           |
| POST   | /api/v1/pdf/rotate         | `file`, `angle` (90/180/270), optional `pages`      | rotated PDF                       |
| POST   | /api/v1/pdf/compress       | `file`, optional `image_dpi`/`image_quality`        | smaller PDF                       |
| POST   | /api/v1/pdf/watermark      | `file`, `text`, optional `opacity`/`font_size`/`color`/`angle`/`pages` | stamped PDF     |
| POST   | /api/v1/pdf/info           | `file`                                             | JSON: page count, metadata, size  |
| POST   | /api/v1/pdf/to-text        | `file`, optional `pages`                           | JSON `{pages:[{page,text}]}`      |
| POST   | /api/v1/pdf/to-images      | `file`, optional `pages`/`dpi`/`format`             | ZIP of page images                |
| POST   | /api/v1/pdf/from-images    | `files` (PNG/JPEG)                                 | one PDF, one page per image       |
| POST   | /api/v1/pdf/sign           | `file`, `cert` (.p12/.pfx), `passphrase`, optional `reason`/`location`/`field_name` | PAdES-signed PDF (with trusted timestamp) |
| POST   | /api/v1/pdf/verify-signature | `file`                                           | JSON signature report (signer, integrity, timestamp) |
| POST   | /api/v1/pdf/ocr            | `file`, optional `language`/`pdfa`                 | searchable PDF / PDF-A            |
| POST   | /api/v1/pdf/extract-tables | `file`                                             | JSON tables (rows + markdown)     |
| POST   | /api/v1/convert/to-pdf     | Office doc (doc/docx/odt/rtf/txt/xls/xlsx/ods/csv/ppt/pptx/odp/html) | PDF |
| POST   | /api/v1/convert/pdf-to-docx| `file` (PDF)                                       | editable Word .docx               |

### Images

| Method | Path                        | Request                                  | Response                       |
|--------|-----------------------------|--------------------------------------------|----------------------------------|
| POST   | /api/v1/image/remove-bg     | `image`                                     | PNG, transparent background     |
| POST   | /api/v1/image/edit          | `image`, `prompt`                           | PNG (AI-edited)                 |
| POST   | /api/v1/image/detect-watermarks | `image`                                 | JSON `{watermarks:[{x,y,w,h,label,confidence}]}` |
| POST   | /api/v1/image/inpaint       | `image`, `mask`, optional `prompt`/`radius`  | PNG                              |

### Video

| Method | Path                     | Request                                                    | Response          |
|--------|--------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------|
| POST   | /api/v1/video/download   | JSON `{url, format: "mp3"\|"mp4"}`                          | binary file stream |
| POST   | /api/v1/video/remove-logo| `file`, `logo_preset`, `watermark_position`, `logo_scale`    | MP4                |

### PDF watermark removal (region-based, not AI-detect)

| Method | Path                        | Request                                          | Response     |
|--------|-----------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|---------------|
| POST   | /api/v1/pdf/remove-watermark| `file`, `regions` (JSON), `method` (telea/ns/gemini) | cleaned PDF |

## Errors

Failures return JSON with a `detail` field. Structured errors carry a `code`:

| Status | code               | Meaning                                    |
|--------|--------------------|----------------------------------------------|
| 400    | —                  | bad input (malformed file, missing param)   |
| 401    | —                  | missing/invalid API key                      |
| 403    | insufficient_scope | your key lacks the scope for this endpoint  |
| 413    | —                  | file over the size limit                     |
| 429    | rate_limited       | over 30 requests/minute — back off and retry |
| 429    | quota_exceeded     | over your monthly quota                      |
| 503    | —                  | this feature isn't enabled on this deployment (check /api/v1/capabilities) |

## Scopes

Self-serve keys are issued with full access (`*`) by default. If you request
a scoped key from an admin, scopes map to endpoint groups:

    pdf.read  -> info, to-text, to-images, extract-tables, verify-signature
    pdf.write -> merge, split, delete-pages, rotate, compress, watermark,
                 from-images, ocr, remove-watermark
    pdf.sign  -> sign
    pdf       -> all of the above
    convert   -> to-pdf, pdf-to-docx
    image     -> remove-bg, edit, inpaint, detect-watermarks
    video     -> download, remove-logo
    *         -> everything

## Connect an AI assistant (MCP)

The @champ-deep/champdf-mcp package wraps this whole API as tools for
Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, and any other MCP-aware client:

    claude mcp add champdf \
      -e CHAMPDF_API_KEY=champdf_live_... \
      -e CHAMPDF_API_BASE_URL=https://champdf-api.64.227.154.215.sslip.io \
      -- npx -y @champ-deep/champdf-mcp

Or add to Claude Desktop / Cursor's MCP config:

    {
      "mcpServers": {
        "champdf": {
          "command": "npx",
          "args": ["-y", "@champ-deep/champdf-mcp"],
          "env": {
            "CHAMPDF_API_KEY": "champdf_live_...",
            "CHAMPDF_API_BASE_URL": "https://champdf-api.64.227.154.215.sslip.io"
          }
        }
      }
    }

Then just ask: "merge these two PDFs", "sign this contract with my
certificate", "remove the background from this photo".

## Quickstart

    # 1. Get your key: sign in at champdf.com -> API pill -> Generate

    # 2. Use it
    curl -X POST https://champdf-api.64.227.154.215.sslip.io/api/v1/image/remove-bg \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer champdf_live_..." \
      -F "image=@photo.jpg" \
      -o photo-no-bg.png

    # 3. Check usage
    curl https://champdf-api.64.227.154.215.sslip.io/api/v1/whoami \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer champdf_live_..."
